description.text: Under the Lord Ruler it was a quiet street of shops, such as tailors and jewellers, serving only the nobility.

items.text: Lord Renoux suggested Vin buy new earrings on Kenton Street to replace the stud she always wore, but she refused and kept her earring.
Once Elend lifted the restrictions on skaa merchants and wages, Kenton Street became a busy market, with merchants hiring criers and jugglers to draw customers.

During the siege of Luthadel, Tindwyl took Allrianne and Vin dress-shopping there, and Vin noticed merchants asking five boxings for a box of old apples. Elend afterwards had Ham bring the street's clothing merchants to see the refugees, hoping it would make them lower their prices.
